title: Complete the omitted six-source one-TRIO census domain
head: 118c081602212891e3ed565a09f2ab32feb04f28
body:
PR2134's maintainer review identified legal source-count profiles omitted by its two-profile filter. This completes the exact six-source, thirteen-singleton plus one-TRIO domain: five profiles, 5,675,670 canonical words, including 3,333,330 formerly omitted cases. A separately written multiplicity-first Python enumerator and native RGS/direct-pair enumeration agree on every histogram. The claimed maximum survives: 61 of 63 nonzero masks, attained by 88 words. Its credited completed bill remains 144 unit calls, versus 142 for the singleton incumbent.

The package proves profile completeness and the cyclic closed-path rotation that puts the unique TRIO last while preserving all paired differences. Arbitrary call commutation is not used. It retains the exact predecessor search, certificate and README byte-for-byte with source pins and attribution, and reproduces every old-subdomain histogram bin. This resolves the stated finite review blocker rather than claiming a new construction or enlarging the search.

Validation: Python 3.12.14 registered optimized replay; GCC 16.2 full census; Python 3.14.5 optimized Git-free/read-only export; typed receipt, external/vendor source corruption, whitespace, overwrite and CLI controls. Independent model-assisted proof review is separate from these computations. No native TRIO admission, supplier budget, CI/full selected replay or new kappa claim.

Start b5ea56e0, priority5. Prepublication canonical main 6bd33bc0 has unchanged guidance/selected inputs; newly incorporated 12-call PR2146 is a distinct domain. Open PR snapshot 17:45 UTC and Discussion snapshot 15:22 UTC have bounded coverage; targeted PR2134 head/comments remain unchanged except our claim. Canonical investigation: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2134#issuecomment-6198385003 . Credit 1337isnot1337 and the maintainer review; ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
